engine: r1864's section-announce — a thin line-art COMPASS-ROSE / quatrefoil ornament (concentric circles + a 4-petal flower from 4 overlapping circles + N/S/E/W rays + a centre dot) that DRAWS + scales + fades in as a section announces itself, sitting above a small kicker, a giant serif display TITLE, body, and a framed CTA. The neoclassical 'this is a new chapter' opener. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18642 'В САМОМ СЕРДЦЕ МОСКВЫ'; r18644 /history 'ИСТОРИЯ МЕСТА').

measured_teardown.move: scroll-into-view reveal, progress p 0..1. The ornament fades opacity 0->1 + scales scaleFrom(0.55)->1 over 0..0.45, and its stroke paths DRAW (stroke-dashoffset length->0) over 0..0.6 (+ optional rotate settle). Then the kicker fades 0.35..0.55; the serif title fades + translateY 24->0 over 0.45..0.75; the body + CTA fade + rise 0.70..1.0. ease power3.out per channel. set(p) is a PURE scrub.
measured_teardown.cited: r18642: a line-art compass-rose (4-point star rays + a quatrefoil of 4 overlapping circles + centre dot) above the kicker 'НА ЗОЛОТОМ ОСТРОВЕ НАПРОТИВ КРЕМЛЯ', a giant serif 'В САМОМ СЕРДЦЕ МОСКВЫ', body, and a framed 'ПОДРОБНЕЕ' CTA. r18644 /history: a smaller quatrefoil-in-a-square ornament above 'ИСТОРИЯ МЕСТА'.

draw.what: draw the ornament strokes via stroke-dashoffset; false = appear without the draw, only scale/fade.

scaleFrom.what: the ornament's starting scale; grows to 1 as it appears.

rotateFrom.what: optional starting rotation (deg) that settles to 0 — a subtle spin-in for a compass feel.

once.what: play once or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when the page drives a shared Lenis.

entry: CompassRoseSectionDivider.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), play(), refresh(), destroy }. target = .crd-stage > svg.crd-rose ([data-draw] stroke paths) + .crd-kicker + .crd-title + .crd-body + .crd-cta. set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of the announce.
law: stroke-dashoffset + transform(scale, rotate, translateY) + opacity only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown. owns_pin false (a scroll-into-view announce). GSAP + ScrollTrigger required; set(p) standalone. The ornament is hand-authored inline SVG (concentric circles + quatrefoil + rays).
gate_mode: scroll-into-view reveal (not pinned). Verify: the ornament draws (dashoffset->0) + scales 0.55->1 + fades; then kicker -> title -> body -> CTA in sequence. Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: the ornament sits at the top of the section — to screenshot it, scroll so the rose is in frame (it can be just above a default crop).
proven: lab: a line-art compass-rose (N/S/E/W rays + a 4-circle quatrefoil + centre dot) above 'НА ЗОЛОТОМ ОСТРОВЕ НАПРОТИВ КРЕМЛЯ' + 'В САМОМ СЕРДЦЕ МОСКВЫ' + body + 'ПОДРОБНЕЕ' CTA. Curve measured live (p / rose-op / rose-scale / draw0-off / kicker / title / cta): 0 / 0 / 0.55 / 20 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.30 / 0.96 / 0.98 / 3 / 0 / 0 / 0 -> 0.55 / 1 / 1 / 0 / 1 / 0.70 / 0 -> 0.80 / 1 / 1 / 0 / 1 / 1 / 0.70 -> 1 / 1 / 1 / 0 / 1 / 1 / 1. Ornament draws + scales in, then kicker/title/body/CTA stagger. Screenshot: the quatrefoil compass-rose drawn + the serif announce (matches r1864). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 0.2% long frames, 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. Serif = Playfair Display (Didot/Bodoni class).
